description: This Dart source file defines the SupabaseConfig class responsible for initializing the Supabase client in a Flutter application. It loads environment variables, handles missing configuration, and exposes the client instance.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A utility class for initializing and accessing a Supabase client in a Flutter app.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file and initializes the Supabase client with these configurations. Designed to be called during app startup.

methods.name: client
methods.description: A getter that returns the current Supabase client instance.
